description: Feature conditions accept token methods with their usual values and types (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $ = "a", $.split(" ") = "a".split(" "), $.tags = A, $.first-token.classes = A, $.last-token.value = "a", $.tokens-after-first.value = "", $.image = "a", $.source-text = "a", $.decomposed-source-text = "a", $.value.split(" ") = "a".split(" "), $
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A

```
